Context: 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-

Where, on conclusion of the departmental proceedings, DA is of the tentative view that no formal penalty needs to be imposed and refers the case for second stage consultation with CVC and if CVC advises imposition of a penalty which the DA on consideration decides not to accept, then it becomes a case of disagreement between DA and CVC and requires resolution by DoP&T. - GID (49), Rule 14.
